newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil firmer at close on covering.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil firmer at close on covering.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed firmer on shortcovering by commission houses, while players continued to await more crop data next week. Earlier prices were easier due to lower soyoil futures. Trading was fairly cautious.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also turned higher but interest was scattered among CPOs and selected oils.
Malaysian palm oil prices closed the week on a firmer note due to shortcovering by commission houses, but trading remained cautious with players awaiting key crop data next week, dealers said.
"Sentiment turned slightly better in late trading on covering by commission houses," a trader said. But he added that price movement was limited as there was no fresh development to create activity.
The market is waiting for the release of official key April export/output/stock data and first-half May export data next week.
Earlier in the day, palm prices eased on lower soyoil prices, and expectations of rising output in coming months due to high harvest seasons.
Traders said technically, the market was still weak and should be trading between 1,250 and 1,270 ringgit for third-month July futures.
At the close, the July contract was up two ringgit to 1,267 ringgit ($505.38) a tonne. Turnover on futures was 1,337 lots.

Physicals saw scattered dealing with May (south) crude palm oil was offering at 1,355 ringgit against bids of 1,350 after trading at 1,350. May (central) saw offers at 1,335 against bids of 1,330 with earlier trades done at 1,327.50 and 1,330. June (south) was offered at 1,335 versus 1,330 with earlier trades at 1,325 and 1,330.

Among refined products, May was offered at $565 a tonne FOB Malaysia, June $560, July at $555 and July/Aug/Sept at $547.50. May RBD palm olein saw offers at $605, June at $595, July at $585, and July/Aug/Sept at $580. May RBD palm stearin was offered at $430 and June at $427.50 and May/June palm fatty acid distillate at $285.
